---
title: "Calculate ALL vs. NO track errors"
format: html
editor: visual
---


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(geosphere)
library(reldist) # For weighted quantiles

# Set the working directory to the project root
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = rprojroot::find_rstudio_root_file())

SAVE_FIG <- FALSE
SAVE_DATA <- FALSE

output_dir <- "Hurricanes_output/augmented_obs"
```

# 1. Load and process the track data

```{r}
if (!SAVE_DATA) {
  tracks_best <- read_csv(file.path(output_dir, "tracks_best.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
  tracks_all <- read_csv(file.path(output_dir, "tracks_all.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
  tracks_no <- read_csv(file.path(output_dir, "tracks_no.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
  tracks_forecast <- read_csv(file.path(output_dir, "tracks_forecast.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
  tracks_data <- read_csv(file.path(output_dir, "tracks_data.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
} else {
  ATCF_headers <- c("BASIN", "CY", "YYYYMMDDHH", "TECHNUM", "TECH", "TAU", 
                                "LAT", "LON", "VMAX", "MSLP", "TY", "RAD", 
                                "WINDCODE", "RAD1", "RAD2", "RAD3", "RAD4", 
                                "POUTER", "ROUTER", "RMW", "GUSTS", "EYE", 
                                "SUBREGION", "MAXSEAS", "INITIALS", "DIR", 
                                "SPEED", "STORMNAME", "DEPTH", "SEAS", 
                                "SEASCODE", "SEAS1", "SEAS2", "SEAS3", 
                                "SEAS4")


  # The raw DAT files have inconsistent number of columns, with first rows ending without the last columns.
  # The code below fixes that by reading the file and forcing it to complete rows_append()
  # Read the file as plain text
  complete_DAT_rows <- function(file, type) {
      lines <- readLines(file)
      
      # Ensure all rows have the correct number of columns by appending commas
      lines <- sapply(lines, function(line) {
        cols <- strsplit(line, ",")[[1]]
        if (length(cols) < length(ATCF_headers)) {
          paste(c(cols, rep("", length(ATCF_headers) - length(cols))), collapse = ",")
        } else {
          line
        }
      })
    return(lines)
  }



  # Function to process each file
  read_track <- function(file, type) {
      
      # Read the file and complete rows
      lines <- complete_DAT_rows(file, type)

      # Write the corrected lines to a temporary file
      temp_file <- tempfile()
      writeLines(lines, temp_file)

      read_csv(temp_file, col_names = ATCF_headers, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
        filter(RAD == 34) %>% # Filter for 34 knots radius
        select(BASIN, CY, YYYYMMDDHH, TAU, LAT, LON, VMAX, RAD1, RAD2, RAD3, RAD4, STORMNAME) %>%
        # Enforce types
        mutate(BASIN = as.character(BASIN),
              CY = as.integer(CY),
              file_time = as.character(YYYYMMDDHH),
              TAU = as.integer(TAU),
              LAT = as.character(LAT),
              LON = as.character(LON),
              VMAX = as.numeric(VMAX),
              RAD1 = as.integer(RAD1),
              RAD2 = as.integer(RAD2),
              RAD3 = as.integer(RAD3),
              RAD4 = as.integer(RAD4),
              STORMNAME = as.character(STORMNAME)) %>%
        # Convert latitude to decimal format: Format ix XXXH. Divide XXX by 10. Then, if H = S, assign negative sign
        mutate(LAT = ifelse(str_detect(LAT, "S"), -as.numeric(str_sub(LAT,1,-2))/10, as.numeric(str_sub(LAT,1,-2))/10),
              LON = ifelse(str_detect(LON, "W"), -as.numeric(str_sub(LON,1,-2))/10, as.numeric(str_sub(LON,1,-2))/10),
              forecast_type = type,
              forecast_time = ymd_h(file_time) + hours(TAU),
              hurricane_id = paste(BASIN, CY, year(forecast_time), sep = "_")) %>%
        select(hurricane_id,
              hurricane_name = STORMNAME,
              file_time,
              forecast_type,
              forecast_time,
              lead_time = TAU,
              lat = LAT,
              lon = LON,
              vmax = VMAX,
              rad1 = RAD1,
              rad2 = RAD2,
              rad3 = RAD3,
              rad4 = RAD4)
  }

  # Load the best track data
  dat_files_best <- list.files(path = file.path(here(), "Hurricane_data/NHC_files"), pattern = "\\.dat$", full.names = TRUE)
  tracks_best <- dat_files_best %>% map_dfr(read_track, type = "Best")
  tracks_best <- tracks_best %>%
    rename(lat_best = lat,
          lon_best = lon,
          vmax_best = vmax,
          rad1_best = rad1,
          rad2_best = rad2,
          rad3_best = rad3,
          rad4_best = rad4)


  # Load the ALL track data
  dat_files_all <- list.files(path = file.path(here(), "Hurricane_data/NHC_files/ALL"), pattern = "\\.atcfunix$", full.names = TRUE)
  tracks_all <- dat_files_all %>% map_dfr(read_track, type = "All")
  tracks_all <- tracks_all %>%
    select(-hurricane_name) %>%
    rename(lat_all = lat,
          lon_all = lon,
          vmax_all = vmax,
          rad1_all = rad1,
          rad2_all = rad2,
          rad3_all = rad3,
          rad4_all = rad4)


  # Load the NO track data
  dat_files_no <- list.files(path = file.path(here(), "Hurricane_data/NHC_files/NO"), pattern = "\\.atcfunix$", full.names = TRUE)
  tracks_no <- dat_files_no %>% map_dfr(read_track, type = "No")
  tracks_no <- tracks_no %>%
    select(-hurricane_name) %>%
    rename(lat_no = lat,
          lon_no = lon,
          vmax_no = vmax,
          rad1_no = rad1,
          rad2_no = rad2,
          rad3_no = rad3,
          rad4_no = rad4)


  # Merge All and No keeping only the matches
  tracks_forecast <- inner_join(tracks_all %>% select(-forecast_type),
                                tracks_no %>% select(-forecast_type), 
                                by = c("hurricane_id", "file_time", "forecast_time", "lead_time"))

  # Save all tracks files
    write_csv(tracks_best, file.path(output_dir, "tracks_best.csv"))
    write_csv(tracks_all, file.path(output_dir, "tracks_all.csv"))
    write_csv(tracks_no, file.path(output_dir, "tracks_no.csv"))
    write_csv(tracks_forecast, file.path(output_dir, "tracks_forecast.csv"))
    write_csv(tracks_data, file.path(output_dir, "tracks_data.csv"))
}
```

Merge with Best track (this will lead to cartesian match because of different lead times for a single prediction time)

```{r}
tracks_data <- inner_join(tracks_forecast,
                           tracks_best  %>% select(-file_time, -forecast_type, -lead_time), 
                                by = c("hurricane_id", "forecast_time")) %>%
                  arrange(hurricane_id, forecast_time, lead_time)
```


Merge tracks with landfall data and calculate time relative to landfall

```{r}
landfall_data <- read_csv(file.path(here(), "Hurricane_data/NHC_files", "landfall_times.csv")) %>%
  mutate(landfall_time = ymd_h(landfall_time))

tracks_data <- tracks_data %>%
  left_join(landfall_data %>% select(-hurricane_name), by = "hurricane_id") %>%
  mutate(time_to_landfall = as.numeric(difftime(landfall_time, ymd_h(file_time), units = "hours")))
```

Calculate Euclidian distances to prediction nodes

```{r}
NMI_TO_M <- 1852 # Nautical miles to meters conversion factor
tracks_data <- tracks_data %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    track_error_all = distHaversine(c(lon_best, lat_best), c(lon_all, lat_all))/NMI_TO_M,
    track_error_no = distHaversine(c(lon_best, lat_best), c(lon_no, lat_no))/NMI_TO_M,
    track_error_abs_reduc = track_error_no - track_error_all,
    track_error_rel_reduc = ifelse(track_error_no != 0, (track_error_no - track_error_all) / track_error_no, 0)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

Calculate vmax errors
```{r}
tracks_data <- tracks_data %>%
  mutate(
    vmax_error_all = vmax_all - vmax_best,
    vmax_error_no = vmax_no - vmax_best,
    vmax_error_abs_reduc = vmax_error_no - vmax_error_all,
    vmax_error_rel_reduc = ifelse(vmax_error_no != 0, (vmax_error_no - vmax_error_all) / vmax_error_no, 0)
  )
```


Calculate storm size at 34 knots radius and prediction errors

```{r}
tracks_data <- tracks_data %>%
  mutate(
    vmax_error_all = vmax_all - vmax_best,
    vmax_error_no = vmax_no - vmax_best,
    vmax_error_reduc = vmax_error_no - vmax_error_all,
    vmax_error_rel_reduc = ifelse(vmax_error_no != 0, (vmax_error_no - vmax_error_all) / vmax_error_no, 0)
  )
```

Calculate storm size at 34 knots radius and prediction errors

```{r}
tracks_data <- tracks_data %>%
  mutate(
    storm_size_best = (rad1_best + rad2_best + rad3_best + rad4_best)/4, # These are already in nautical miles
    storm_size_all = (rad1_all + rad2_all + rad3_all + rad4_all)/4,
    storm_size_no = (rad1_no + rad2_no + rad3_no + rad4_no)/4,
    size_error_all = storm_size_all - storm_size_best,
    size_error_no = storm_size_no - storm_size_best,
    size_error_abs_reduc = size_error_no - size_error_all,
    size_error_rel_reduc = ifelse(size_error_no != 0, (size_error_no - size_error_all) / size_error_no, 0)
)
```

Save the processed data

```{r}
if (SAVE_DATA) {
  write_csv(tracks_data, file.path(output_dir, "tracks_data.csv"))
}
```


# 2. Track plots

Plot the tracks for each storm using the full data available for best, all, and no forecasts

```{r}
unique_ids <- unique(tracks_data$hurricane_id)

for (hurr_id in unique_ids) {
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_path(data = tracks_best %>% filter(hurricane_id == hurr_id), aes(x = lon_best, y = lat_best, color = "Best"), linewidth = 1.5, arrow = arrow(ends = "last")) +
    geom_path(data = tracks_all %>% filter(hurricane_id == hurr_id), aes(x = lon_all, y = lat_all, group = file_time, color = "All"), linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_path(data = tracks_no %>% filter(hurricane_id == hurr_id), aes(x = lon_no, y = lat_no, group = file_time, color = "No"), linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.3) +
    labs(title = paste("Tracks for", hurr_id),
         x = "Longitude",
         y = "Latitude") +
    theme_minimal() +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Best" = "black", "All" = "blue", "No" = "red"), name = "Forecast Type") +
    coord_fixed() +
    theme(legend.position = "right")

  if (SAVE_FIG) ggsave(filename = file.path(output_dir, "tracks", paste0(hurr_id, ".png")), plot = p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 150)
}
```

Next, plot tracks only with matched data points (with the tracks_data dataframe)

```{r}
for (hurr_id in unique_ids) {
  p <- ggplot(tracks_data %>% filter(hurricane_id == hurr_id)) +
    geom_path(aes(x = lon_best, y = lat_best, color = "Best"), linewidth = 1.5, arrow = arrow(ends = "last")) +
    geom_path(aes(x = lon_all, y = lat_all, group = file_time, color = "All"), linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_path(aes(x = lon_no, y = lat_no, group = file_time, color = "No"), linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.3) +
    labs(title = paste("Matched Tracks for", hurr_id),
         x = "Longitude",
         y = "Latitude") +
    theme_minimal() +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Best" = "black", "All" = "blue", "No" = "red"), name = "Forecast Type") +
    coord_fixed() +
    theme(legend.position = "right")
  
  if (SAVE_FIG) ggsave(filename = file.path(output_dir, "tracks", paste0(hurr_id, "_matched.png")), plot = p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 150)
}
```

# 3. Error statistics for lead times

There is a little variation of lead time multiples

```{r}
table(tracks_data$lead_time)
```

Group into ranges of days

```{r}
tracks_data_grouped <- tracks_data %>%
  mutate(lead_days_group = (lead_time %/% 24),
         dtl_group = (time_to_landfall %/% 24)) %>%
  group_by(lead_days_group, dtl_group) %>%
  summarise(
    n_obs = n(),
    mean_track_error_all = mean(track_error_all, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_track_error_all = median(track_error_all, na.rm = TRUE),
    p05_track_error_all = quantile(track_error_all, na.rm = TRUE, probs = 0.05),
    p95_track_error_all = quantile(track_error_all, na.rm = TRUE, probs = 0.95),
    mean_track_error_no = mean(track_error_no, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_track_error_no = median(track_error_no, na.rm = TRUE),
    p05_track_error_no = quantile(track_error_no, na.rm = TRUE, probs = 0.05),
    p95_track_error_no = quantile(track_error_no, na.rm = TRUE, probs = 0.95),
    mean_track_error_abs_reduc = mean(track_error_abs_reduc, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_track_error_abs_reduc = median(track_error_abs_reduc, na.rm = TRUE),
    p05_track_error_abs_reduc = quantile(track_error_abs_reduc, na.rm = TRUE, probs = 0.05),
    p95_track_error_abs_reduc = quantile(track_error_abs_reduc, na.rm = TRUE, probs = 0.95),
    mean_track_error_rel_reduc = mean(track_error_rel_reduc, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_track_error_rel_reduc = median(track_error_rel_reduc, na.rm = TRUE),
    p05_track_error_rel_reduc = quantile(track_error_rel_reduc, na.rm = TRUE, probs = 0.05),
    p95_track_error_rel_reduc = quantile(track_error_rel_reduc, na.rm = TRUE, probs = 0.95),
    # Calculate vmax errors
    mean_vmax_error_all = mean(vmax_error_all, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_vmax_error_all = median(vmax_error_all, na.rm = TRUE),
    p05_vmax_error_all = quantile(vmax_error_all, na.rm = TRUE, probs = 0.05),
    p95_vmax_error_all = quantile(vmax_error_all, na.rm = TRUE, probs = 0.95),
    mean_vmax_error_no = mean(vmax_error_no, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_vmax_error_no = median(vmax_error_no, na.rm = TRUE),
    p05_vmax_error_no = quantile(vmax_error_no, na.rm = TRUE, probs = 0.05),
    p95_vmax_error_no = quantile(vmax_error_no, na.rm = TRUE, probs = 0.95),
    mean_vmax_error_abs_reduc = mean(vmax_error_abs_reduc, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_vmax_error_abs_reduc = median(vmax_error_abs_reduc, na.rm = TRUE),
    p05_vmax_error_abs_reduc = quantile(vmax_error_abs_reduc, na.rm = TRUE, probs = 0.05),
    p95_vmax_error_abs_reduc = quantile(vmax_error_abs_reduc, na.rm = TRUE, probs = 0.95),
    mean_vmax_error_rel_reduc = mean(vmax_error_rel_reduc, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_vmax_error_rel_reduc = median(vmax_error_rel_reduc, na.rm = TRUE),
    p05_vmax_error_rel_reduc = quantile(vmax_error_rel_reduc, na.rm = TRUE, probs = 0.05),
    p95_vmax_error_rel_reduc = quantile(vmax_error_rel_reduc, na.rm = TRUE, probs = 0.95),
    # Calculate storm size errors
    mean_size_error_all = mean(size_error_all, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_size_error_all = median(size_error_all, na.rm = TRUE),
    p05_size_error_all = quantile(size_error_all, na.rm = TRUE, probs = 0.05),
    p95_size_error_all = quantile(size_error_all, na.rm = TRUE, probs = 0.95),
    mean_size_error_no = mean(size_error_no, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_size_error_no = median(size_error_no, na.rm = TRUE),
    p05_size_error_no = quantile(size_error_no, na.rm = TRUE, probs = 0.05),
    p95_size_error_no = quantile(size_error_no, na.rm = TRUE, probs = 0.95),
    mean_size_error_abs_reduc = mean(size_error_abs_reduc, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_size_error_abs_reduc = median(size_error_abs_reduc, na.rm = TRUE),
    p05_size_error_abs_reduc = quantile(size_error_abs_reduc, na.rm = TRUE, probs = 0.05),
    p95_size_error_abs_reduc = quantile(size_error_abs_reduc, na.rm = TRUE, probs = 0.95),
    mean_size_error_rel_reduc = mean(size_error_rel_reduc, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_size_error_rel_reduc = median(size_error_rel_reduc, na.rm = TRUE),
    p05_size_error_rel_reduc = quantile(size_error_rel_reduc, na.rm = TRUE, probs = 0.05),
    p95_size_error_rel_reduc = quantile(size_error_rel_reduc, na.rm = TRUE, probs = 0.95),
    ## Metrics weighted by true size for track error
    wtd_mean_track_error_all = weighted.mean(track_error_all, storm_size_best, na.rm = TRUE),
    wtd_median_track_error_all = wtd.quantile(track_error_all, q = 0.5, na.rm = TRUE, weight = storm_size_best),
    wtd_p05_track_error_all = wtd.quantile(track_error_all, q = 0.05, na.rm = TRUE, weight = storm_size_best),
    wtd_p95_track_error_all = wtd.quantile(track_error_all, q = 0.95, na.rm = TRUE, weight = storm_size_best),
    wtd_mean_track_error_no = weighted.mean(track_error_no, storm_size_best, na.rm = TRUE),
    wtd_median_track_error_no = wtd.quantile(track_error_no, q = 0.5, na.rm = TRUE, weight = storm_size_best),
    wtd_p05_track_error_no = wtd.quantile(track_error_no, q = 0.05, na.rm = TRUE, weight = storm_size_best),
    wtd_p95_track_error_no = wtd.quantile(track_error_no, q = 0.95, na.rm = TRUE, weight = storm_size_best),
    wtd_mean_track_error_abs_reduc = weighted.mean(track_error_abs_reduc, storm_size_best, na.rm = TRUE),
    wtd_median_track_error_abs_reduc = wtd.quantile(track_error_abs_reduc, q = 0.5, na.rm = TRUE, weight = storm_size_best),  
    wtd_p05_track_error_abs_reduc = wtd.quantile(track_error_abs_reduc, q = 0.05, na.rm = TRUE, weight = storm_size_best),
    wtd_p95_track_error_abs_reduc = wtd.quantile(track_error_abs_reduc, q = 0.95, na.rm = TRUE, weight = storm_size_best),
    wtd_mean_track_error_rel_reduc = weighted.mean(track_error_rel_reduc, storm_size_best, na.rm = TRUE),
    wtd_median_track_error_rel_reduc = wtd.quantile(track_error_rel_reduc, q = 0.5, na.rm = TRUE, weight = storm_size_best),
    wtd_p05_track_error_rel_reduc = wtd.quantile(track_error_rel_reduc, q = 0.05, na.rm = TRUE, weight = storm_size_best),
    wtd_p95_track_error_rel_reduc = wtd.quantile(track_error_rel_reduc, q = 0.95, na.rm = TRUE, weight = storm_size_best),
    ## Metrics weighted by true size for vmax error
    wtd_mean_vmax_error_all = weighted.mean(vmax_error_all, storm_size_best, na.rm = TRUE),
    wtd_median_vmax_error_all = wtd.quantile(vmax_error_all, q = 0.5, na.rm = TRUE, weight = storm_size_best),
    wtd_p05_vmax_error_all = wtd.quantile(vmax_error_all, q = 0.05, na.rm = TRUE, weight = storm_size_best),
    wtd_p95_vmax_error_all = wtd.quantile(vmax_error_all, q = 0.95, na.rm = TRUE, weight = storm_size_best),
    wtd_mean_vmax_error_no = weighted.mean(vmax_error_no, storm_size_best, na.rm = TRUE),
    wtd_median_vmax_error_no = wtd.quantile(vmax_error_no, q = 0.5, na.rm = TRUE, weight = storm_size_best),
    wtd_p05_vmax_error_no = wtd.quantile(vmax_error_no, q = 0.05, na.rm = TRUE, weight = storm_size_best),
    wtd_p95_vmax_error_no = wtd.quantile(vmax_error_no, q = 0.95, na.rm = TRUE, weight = storm_size_best),
    wtd_mean_vmax_error_abs_reduc = weighted.mean(vmax_error_abs_reduc, storm_size_best, na.rm = TRUE),
    wtd_median_vmax_error_abs_reduc = wtd.quantile(vmax_error_abs_reduc, q = 0.5, na.rm = TRUE, weight = storm_size_best),
    wtd_p05_vmax_error_abs_reduc = wtd.quantile(vmax_error_abs_reduc, q = 0.05, na.rm = TRUE, weight = storm_size_best),
    wtd_p95_vmax_error_abs_reduc = wtd.quantile(vmax_error_abs_reduc, q = 0.95, na.rm = TRUE, weight = storm_size_best),
    wtd_mean_vmax_error_rel_reduc = weighted.mean(vmax_error_rel_reduc, storm_size_best, na.rm = TRUE),
    wtd_median_vmax_error_rel_reduc = wtd.quantile(vmax_error_rel_reduc, q = 0.5, na.rm = TRUE, weight = storm_size_best),
    wtd_p05_vmax_error_rel_reduc = wtd.quantile(vmax_error_rel_reduc, q = 0.05, na.rm = TRUE, weight = storm_size_best),

    wtd_mean_size_error_abs_reduc = weighted.mean(size_error_abs_reduc, storm_size_best, na.rm = TRUE),
    wtd_median_size_error_abs_reduc = wtd.quantile(size_error_abs_reduc, q = 0.5, na.rm = TRUE, weight = storm_size_best),
    wtd_p05_size_error_abs_reduc = wtd.quantile(size_error_abs_reduc, q = 0.05, na.rm = TRUE, weight = storm_size_best),
    wtd_p95_size_error_abs_reduc = wtd.quantile(size_error_abs_reduc, q = 0.95, na.rm = TRUE, weight = storm_size_best),
    wtd_mean_size_error_rel_reduc = weighted.mean(size_error_rel_reduc, storm_size_best, na.rm = TRUE),
    wtd_median_size_error_rel_reduc = wtd.quantile(size_error_rel_reduc, q = 0.5, na.rm = TRUE, weight = storm_size_best),
    wtd_p05_size_error_rel_reduc = wtd.quantile(size_error_rel_reduc, q = 0.05, na.rm = TRUE, weight = storm_size_best),
    wtd_p95_size_error_rel_reduc = wtd.quantile(size_error_rel_reduc, q = 0.95, na.rm = TRUE, weight = storm_size_best)
)
```



 General plotting function for error statistics
```{r}
plot_error_stats <- function(data, 
                             error_type = c("track", "vmax", "size"), 
                             weighted = FALSE, 
                             output_dir = "Hurricanes_output/augmented_obs/track_errors") {
  error_type <- match.arg(error_type)
  stat_prefix <- if (weighted) "wtd_" else ""
  
  # Set variable names based on error type and weighting
  mean_all   <- paste0(stat_prefix, "mean_", error_type, "_error_all")
  median_all <- paste0(stat_prefix, "median_", error_type, "_error_all")
  p05_all    <- paste0(stat_prefix, "p05_", error_type, "_error_all")
  p95_all    <- paste0(stat_prefix, "p95_", error_type, "_error_all")
  mean_no    <- paste0(stat_prefix, "mean_", error_type, "_error_no")
  median_no  <- paste0(stat_prefix, "median_", error_type, "_error_no")
  p05_no     <- paste0(stat_prefix, "p05_", error_type, "_error_no")
  p95_no     <- paste0(stat_prefix, "p95_", error_type, "_error_no")
  mean_abs_reduc   <- paste0(stat_prefix, "mean_", error_type, "_error_abs_reduc")
  median_abs_reduc <- paste0(stat_prefix, "median_", error_type, "_error_abs_reduc")
  p05_abs_reduc    <- paste0(stat_prefix, "p05_", error_type, "_error_abs_reduc")
  p95_abs_reduc    <- paste0(stat_prefix, "p95_", error_type, "_error_abs_reduc")
  mean_rel_reduc   <- paste0(stat_prefix, "mean_", error_type, "_error_rel_reduc")
  median_rel_reduc <- paste0(stat_prefix, "median_", error_type, "_error_rel_reduc")
  p05_rel_reduc    <- paste0(stat_prefix, "p05_", error_type, "_error_rel_reduc")
  p95_rel_reduc    <- paste0(stat_prefix, "p95_", error_type, "_error_rel_reduc")
  
  # Y labels
  ylab <- switch(error_type,
    track = "Track Error (nmi)",
    vmax  = "Vmax Error (kt)",
    size  = "Size Error (nmi)"
  )
  ylab_abs_reduc <- paste("Error reduction (", sub("Error.*", "", ylab), ")", sep = "")
  ylab_rel_reduc <- "Error reduction (%)"
  
  # File name prefix
  fname_prefix <- paste0(if (weighted) "wtd_" else "", error_type, "_error")
  
  # 1. Absolute errors (All vs No)
  p1 <- ggplot(data %>% filter(dtl_group >= -6 & dtl_group <= 5), aes(x = lead_days_group)) +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = -dtl_group), color = "orange", linetype = "dotted") +
    geom_line(aes(y = .data[[mean_all]], color = "All", linetype = "Mean")) +
    geom_line(aes(y = .data[[median_all]], color = "All", linetype = "Median")) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = .data[[p05_all]], ymax = .data[[p95_all]], fill = "All"), alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_line(aes(y = .data[[mean_no]], color = "No", linetype = "Mean")) +
    geom_line(aes(y = .data[[median_no]], color = "No", linetype = "Median")) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = .data[[p05_no]], ymax = .data[[p95_no]], fill = "No"), alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_col(aes(y = n_obs), fill = "gray60", alpha = 0.15) +
    facet_wrap(~ dtl_group, ncol = 6, scale = "fixed") +
    xlim(-0.6, 5.6) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = ylab,
      sec.axis = sec_axis(~ ., name = "Count")
    ) +    
    labs(title = paste("Absolute", error_type, "errors"),
         subtitle = "Grouped by days since landfall (orange line)",
         caption = "Ranges: 5th and 95th percentiles.",
         x = "Lead days",
         linetype = "Statistic",
         color = "Forecast Type",
         fill = "Forecast Type") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank())
  ggsave(filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0(fname_prefix, "_comparison.png")), plot = p1, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300)
  
  # 2. Absolute error reduction
  p2 <- ggplot(data %>% filter(dtl_group >= -6 & dtl_group <= 5), aes(x = lead_days_group)) +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = -dtl_group), color = "orange", linetype = "dotted") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray70", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_col(aes(y = n_obs), fill = "gray60", alpha = 0.15) +
    geom_line(aes(y = .data[[mean_abs_reduc]], color = "All", linetype = "Mean")) +
    geom_line(aes(y = .data[[median_abs_reduc]], color = "All", linetype = "Median")) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = .data[[p05_abs_reduc]], ymax = .data[[p95_abs_reduc]], fill = "All"), alpha = 0.2) +
    facet_wrap(~ dtl_group, ncol = 6, scale = "fixed") +
    xlim(-0.6, 5.6) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = ylab_abs_reduc,
      sec.axis = sec_axis(~ ., name = "Count")
    ) +
    labs(title = paste("Absolute", error_type, "errors reduction"),
         subtitle = "Grouped by days since landfall (orange line)",
         caption = "Ranges: 5th and 95th percentiles.",
         x = "Lead days",
         linetype = "Statistic",
         color = "Forecast Type",
         fill = "Forecast Type") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank())
  ggsave(filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0(fname_prefix, "_abs_reduc.png")), plot = p2, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 150)
  
  # 3. Relative error reduction
  p3 <- ggplot(data %>% filter(dtl_group >= -6 & dtl_group <= 5), aes(x = lead_days_group)) +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = -dtl_group), color = "orange", linetype = "dotted") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray70", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_line(aes(y = .data[[mean_rel_reduc]]*100, color = "All", linetype = "Mean")) +
    geom_line(aes(y = .data[[median_rel_reduc]]*100, color = "All", linetype = "Median")) +
    #geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = .data[[p05_rel_reduc]]*100, ymax = .data[[p95_rel_reduc]]*100, fill = "All"), alpha = 0.2) +
    facet_wrap(~ dtl_group, ncol = 6, scale = "fixed") +
    xlim(-0.6, 5.6) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = ylab_abs_reduc,
      sec.axis = sec_axis(~ ., name = "Count")
    ) +
    labs(title = paste("Relative", error_type, "errors reduction"),
         subtitle = "Grouped by days to landfall (orange line)",
         caption = "Ranges: 5th and 95th percentiles.",
         x = "Lead days",
         linetype = "Statistic",
         color = "Forecast Type") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank())
  ggsave(filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0(fname_prefix, "_rel_reduc.png")), plot = p3, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 150)
  
  # 4. Absolute error reduction vs time to landfall (stacked)
  p4 <- ggplot(data %>% filter(dtl_group >= -6 & dtl_group <= 5), aes(x = lead_days_group+dtl_group)) +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 0), color = "orange", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "red", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_line(aes(y = .data[[mean_abs_reduc]], color = factor(dtl_group), linetype = "Mean", group = dtl_group)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = .data[[median_abs_reduc]], color = factor(dtl_group), linetype = "Median", group = dtl_group)) +
    scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Days since landfall",
                          option = "D",
                          begin = 0.1,
                          end = 0.9) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-5, 5, by = 1)) +
    labs(title = paste("Absolute", error_type, "errors reduction"),
         linetype = "Statistic",
         x = "Time to landfall (days)",
         y = ylab_abs_reduc) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank())
  ggsave(filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0(fname_prefix, "_abs_reduc_ttl.png")), plot = p4, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 150)
  
  # 5. Relative error reduction vs time to landfall (stacked)
  p5 <- ggplot(data %>% filter(dtl_group >= -6 & dtl_group <= 5), aes(x = lead_days_group+dtl_group)) +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 0), color = "orange", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "red", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_line(aes(y = .data[[mean_rel_reduc]]*100, color = factor(dtl_group), linetype = "Mean", group = dtl_group)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = .data[[median_rel_reduc]]*100, color = factor(dtl_group), linetype = "Median", group = dtl_group)) +
    scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Days since landfall",
                          option = "D",
                          begin = 0.1,
                          end = 0.9) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-5, 5, by = 1)) +
    labs(title = paste("Relative", error_type, "errors reduction"),
        linetype = "Statistic",
         x = "Time to landfall (days)",
         y = ylab_rel_reduc) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank())
  ggsave(filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0(fname_prefix, "_rel_reduc_ttl.png")), plot = p5, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 150)
  
  invisible(list(abs_error = p1, abs_reduc = p2, rel_reduc = p3, abs_reduc_ttl = p4, rel_reduc_ttl = p5))
}
```

```{r}
  summarise(
    n_obs = n(),
    mean_track_error_all = mean(track_error_all, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_track_error_all = median(track_error_all, na.rm = TRUE),
    p05_track_error_all = quantile(track_error_all, na.rm = TRUE, probs = 0.05),
    p95_track_error_all = quantile(track_error_all, na.rm = TRUE, probs = 0.95),
    mean_track_error_no = mean(track_error_no, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_track_error_no = median(track_error_no, na.rm = TRUE),
    p05_track_error_no = quantile(track_error_no, na.rm = TRUE, probs = 0.05),
    p95_track_error_no = quantile(track_error_no, na.rm = TRUE, probs = 0.95),
    mean_track_error_abs_reduc = mean(track_error_abs_reduc, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_track_error_abs_reduc = median(track_error_abs_reduc, na.rm = TRUE),
    p05_track_error_abs_reduc = quantile(track_error_abs_reduc, na.rm = TRUE, probs = 0.05),

    mean_track_error_rel_reduc = mean(track_error_rel_reduc, na.rm = TRUE),

    mean_vmax_error_rel_reduc = mean(vmax_error_rel_reduc, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_vmax_error_rel_reduc = median(vmax_error_rel_reduc, na.rm = TRUE),
    p05_vmax_error_rel_reduc = quantile(vmax_error_rel_reduc, na.rm = TRUE, probs = 0.05),
    p95_vmax_error_rel_reduc = quantile(vmax_error_rel_reduc, na.rm = TRUE, probs = 0.95),

    p05_size_error_no = quantile(size_error_no, na.rm = TRUE, probs = 0.05),
    p95_size_error_no = quantile(size_error_no, na.rm = TRUE, probs = 0.95),
    mean_size_error_abs_reduc = mean(size_error_abs_reduc, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_size_error_abs_reduc = median(size_error_abs_reduc, na.rm = TRUE),
    p05_size_error_abs_reduc = quantile(size_error_abs_reduc, na.rm = TRUE, probs = 0.05),
```

4. Error statistics per storm

Here, errors are aggregate in pre vs post landfall periods for each storm. 


```{r}
tracks_data_storm <- tracks_data %>%
  # Limit only to 6 days before and after landfall
  filter(time_to_landfall >= -6*24 & time_to_landfall <= 5*24) %>%
  mutate(lead_days_group = (lead_time %/% 24),
         post_lf = (time_to_landfall >= 0)) %>%
  group_by(lead_days_group, post_lf, hurricane_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    max_vmax_best = max(vmax_best, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_size_best = max(storm_size_best, na.rm = TRUE),
    # Calculate track errors
    mean_track_error_abs_reduc = mean(track_error_abs_reduc, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_track_error_abs_reduc = median(track_error_abs_reduc, na.rm = TRUE),
    # Calculate vmax errors
    mean_vmax_error_abs_reduc = mean(vmax_error_abs_reduc, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_vmax_error_abs_reduc = median(vmax_error_abs_reduc, na.rm = TRUE),
    # Calculate storm size errors
    mean_size_error_abs_reduc = mean(size_error_abs_reduc, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_size_error_abs_reduc = median(size_error_abs_reduc, na.rm = TRUE),
)
```

Add storm name

```{r}
tracks_data_storm <- tracks_data_storm %>%
  left_join(landfall_data %>% select(hurricane_id, hurricane_name),
            by = "hurricane_id") %>%
  mutate(hurricane_name = ifelse(is.na(hurricane_name), hurricane_id, hurricane_name))
``` 

Plot max vmax and size for each storm
```{r}
tracks_data_storm %>%
  filter(post_lf == TRUE) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = hurricane_name)) +
  geom_bar(aes(y = max_size_best), stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  #scale_y_reverse() +
  labs(title = "Maximum size per storm",
       x = "",
       y = "Size (nmi)",
       fill = "Legend") +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave(filename = file.path(output_dir, "storm_max_size.png"), width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 150)

tracks_data_storm %>%
  filter(post_lf == TRUE) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = hurricane_name)) +
  geom_bar(aes(y = max_vmax_best), stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  #scale_y_reverse() +
  labs(title = "Maximum wind speed per storm",
       x = "",
       y = "Vmax (kt)",
       fill = "Legend") +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave(filename = file.path(output_dir, "storm_max_vmax.png"), width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 150)
```



Plot absolute error reduction for each storm

```{r}
ggplot(tracks_data_storm, aes(x = lead_days_group)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray70", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_line(aes(y = mean_track_error_abs_reduc, group = hurricane_name, color = max_size_best)) +
  facet_wrap(~ post_lf, ncol = 2, scale = "fixed", 
       labeller = as_labeller(c(`FALSE` = "Pre", `TRUE` = "Post"))) +
  xlim(0, 5) +
  labs(title = "Mean absolute track errors reduction",
     subtitle = "Pre vs. post landfall",
     x = "Lead days",
     y = "Error reduction (nmi)",
     linetype = "",
     color = "Max size (nmi)") +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "D", begin = 0.1, end = 0.9) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
      panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank())
ggsave(filename = file.path(output_dir, "track_errors", "track_error_abs_reduc_storms_mean.png"), width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 150)
```
